author: Ariadne I
title: Adaptive Dual-Decay (k=128) + Input-Adaptive Temporal Gating + Curvature
abstract: Introduces input-adaptive per-factor temporal gating S[b,t,k] that modulates factor trajectories based on the 4-step input context, atop a dual-decay (two-timescale) LDS with residual copy head. Uses MAE + temporal curvature regularization and global-norm clipping. Rank k=128, gamma 0.25→0.95.
